item.title: El-Sayed separates from Hasan Piker after remarks on Jewish Americans draw criticism
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed has distanced himself from Twitch streamer Hasan Piker following comments about Jewish Americans that triggered bipartisan backlash.

item.title: California governor race polling takes unexpected turn, raising new possibilities
Bessent launches 'Operation Economic Outcast' targeting Iran
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a new initiative to economically isolate Iran, with sanctions on over 60 targets and warnings of further actions.

item.title: Vance says Canada favors China over US in trade, calls it 'insanity'
item.description: JD Vance told Maine voters that Canada treats Chinese goods more favorably than Maine farm products, blaming Ottawa for stalled trade negotiations.
